name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  September 24, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Council Community
Room “A” 1st Floor, on September 24, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt.ReggieJohnson, Los AngelesCountyFire Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Crystal McGlover, Emergency Services

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, Deputy Clerk, City Clerk's Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Sharis Rhodes on behalf of Think True to host the H026 Space Jam Event at 106 E.
  Manchester Blvd, Private Property, on Thursday, October 08, 2026, from 5:00 p.m.
  to 10:00 p.m.; Friday, October 09, 2026, from 9:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.; and Saturday,
  October 10, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Approved Conditionally: Approval
  for a 3-day event within 106 E Manchester Boulevard and Grevillea Art park,
  including Grevillea Avenue and Nutwood Street. Subject to Public Works approval
  for use/closure of the right-of-way. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the
  park. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures; Applicant to hire one (Sergeant) and four (4) officers for public
  safety, and ten (17) TCO’s for traffic control at street closures and drop off areas. In
  addition; applicant shall staff this event with a minimum of fifteen (15)
  professional/licensed security guards on each event day for the safety of attendees
  and equipment, and to assist IPD with potential crowd control. There shall be security
  guards deployed to where the alcohol is being served to prevent underage alcohol
  consumption and the overserving of obviously intoxicated persons. All security
  personnel shall wear reflective vests to be readily identifiable to attendees or the
   general public. No blocking traffic on Manchester Blvd or La Brea Avenue. No
  blocking of fire lanes or emergency ingress / egress. Pedestrian foot traffic on
  sidewalks must be unobstructed and safe at all times. The IPD watch commander
  will be notified, and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time
  permits; Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a
  direct point of contact for the person in charge of sound and acoustics volume
  control; Fire approval conditionally; applicant to supply an indoor site plan to confirm
  the attendance calculations. Any additional needs for staffing will be considered
  once that plan is final and approved; maintain the site at all times, ensuring it is
  properly cleaned immediately upon the end of the event. Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, personal protective
  hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage. No Code Enforcement conditions; No additional
  recommendations needed for Fire approval. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No.282480).

Item #2:  Teresa Estrada on behalf of The City of Inglewood to host the 2026 Harvest Festival
  Event at 1 W. Manchester Blvd, Inglewood City Hall (South Lawn), on Saturday,
  October 17, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. Approved Conditionally: Approval for
  a 1-day event on the South Lawn of City Hall. Subject to Public Works approval.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable mitigation
  measures; Applicant to provide adequate parks & recreation staff for the servicing of
  restrooms that are expected to be utilized by attendees during this event. IPD
  recommends that a minimum of two (2) police officers and two (2) city hall security
  officers be deployed at this event for overall public safety. Security officers should
  allow attendees access to the CH restrooms and assist IPD with any potential crowd
  control. IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol-high visibility will be
  provided as time permits; No Code Enforcement conditions.; No recommendations
  needed for Fire approval; maintain the site at all times, ensuring it is properly cleaned
  immediately after the event. Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No.181180).

Item #3:  Camille Delaney McNeil on behalf of Los Angeles Philharmonic (YOLA) to host the
  Beckmen YOLA Center five (5) Year Celebration Event at 101 S La Brea Ave.;
  Beckmen YOLA Center, on Saturday, October 17, 2026, from 11:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
  Approved Conditionally: Approval for a 1-day event within YOLA parking lot.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable mitigation
  measures; Applicant to hire a minimum of six (6) professional licensed security guards
  for the safety of attendees. All security staff shall wear reflective vests to be readily
   identifiable to attendees or the general public. There shall be NO alcoholic beverages
  permitted during this event. The IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol
  and high visibility will be provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state, and federal
  laws; PWKS; approved it on the condition that the event keeps the alley open at all times;
  Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC
  5-29. Provide a direct point of contact for the person in charge of sound and acoustics
  volume control; No recommendations needed for Fire approval ; Maintain the site at all
  times, ensuring it is cleaned properly immediately upon the end of the event.
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all
  State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No.260260).

Item #4:  Justin Newry on behalf of Culture Cinema LA to host a Culture Cinema LA Presents:
  Black Panther Festival Event at 5354 W 64th St, Frank D Parent School Public
  Property, on Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. - 9:20 p.m. Approved
  Conditionally: Approval for a 1-day event within Franklin D Parent Elementary School.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable mitigation
  measures; Applicant to hire a minimum of six (6) professional licensed security guards
  for the safety of attendees. All security staff shall wear reflective vests to be readily
  identifiable to attendees or the general public. There shall be NO alcoholic beverages
  permitted during this event. The IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol
  and high visibility will be provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state, and federal
  laws; PWKS; Approved per Boytrese Osias, with conditions: Must have own parking area
  for event; The event must not use curb-side parking or guest vehicles; Conditions for
  amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29.
  Provide a direct point of contact for the person in charge of sound and acoustics
  volume control. No recommendations needed for Fire approval. Maintain the site at
  all times, ensuring it is cleaned properly immediately upon the end of the event.
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all
  State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No.0292209)
 Item #5:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following list of
  business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax; adhere to all
  applicable IMC regulations, state and federal law, and the standard
  recommendation applicable to each business type, and all current LA County
  COVID19 guidelines. Motion carried unanimously:

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
